title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN RIVER RESIDENCE, NEW RING
description_en: For sale, Apartment 2+1+2, River Residence, New Ring, Tirana. The apartment is part of a high-quality complex from an investor like Orion Construction, known for the quality and high standard in construction for years. River Residence is located in a very strategic and favorable location, positioned between the Former Aviation Field and the Great Ring Road, easily accessible on foot from December 21. Information about the apartment: • Net area: 111.4 m² • Gross area: 125.9 m² Organization: • 1 Living room + Kitchen area • Matrimonial room, together with a separate wardrobe • 2 Bedrooms • 2 Toilets where one person has a window • Distribution corridor • 1 Balcony Other features: • Optional parking post with extra value • 5th residential floor • Orientation South-East-West For more detailed information or a visit to the property, contact us!
